info.name: QR Card Dating App API - Simplified Flow
info.description:
🎯 **Simplified Admin-Approval Flow**: Users register with name/email → Admin gets notifications → Admin approves/rejects → Automatic email notifications sent.

**Key Features:**
✅ No password authentication required
✅ Admin-controlled user approval system
✅ Automatic email notifications
✅ Complete user journey testing
✅ Enhanced error handling and validation

**📋 Important Endpoints:**
• User Registration: `POST /auth/register` (name + email only)
• Pending Users: `GET /admin/users/pending` (⚠️ NOT /admin/profiles/pending)
• Approve User: `POST /admin/users/{id}/approve`
• Reject User: `POST /admin/users/{id}/reject`

**🚀 Quick Start:** Run 'Complete User Journey' folder to test the full flow.

**📅 Last Updated:** October 13, 2025
**🔧 Version:** 2.1 - Enhanced Simplified Flow
